resources.string: Sign-in and settings changes are only available while parked.

Use Download next to an audiobook in your car’s media browser. If your vehicle does not show that action, start the audiobook, park, then use Download current audiobook below. Finished books appear under Downloads and play without a connection.

Start an audiobook from your server first, then return here while parked.

Before ShelfDrive connects to %1$s, it sends your username and password there for sign-in. If sign-in succeeds, it sends your account or user ID and access token, a random install-scoped app-instance identifier, device model, Android version, and ShelfDrive version. While you use the app—and during enabled background progress sync—it also sends searches, selected titles, playback actions, listening position, progress, and history to that server.\n\nThe ShelfDrive developer does not receive this data. The operator of the server you chose controls its storage, retention, sharing, and deletion. ShelfDrive requires HTTPS, but you should continue only if you trust that server and its operator.
Sign-in confirmation expired. Review your details and tap Sign in again.
No browser is available. The privacy policy remains shown here in Settings.

Effective 28 August 2026. ShelfDrive is published by JediBkApps, operated by Christian Brooker. ShelfDrive connects only to the Audiobookshelf server you choose. To provide sign-in, browsing, playback, offline downloads, and progress sync, the app sends your username and password during sign-in, then account/user identifiers, access tokens, a random install-scoped app-instance identifier and device details, and listening/playback activity to that server over HTTPS. Your password is not retained.

Account tokens, server settings, listening state, cached artwork, partial downloads, and completed offline audiobooks are stored on this vehicle. Downloaded audio is kept in ShelfDrive’s app-specific external-files directory; Android 10 and later protect it with scoped storage, while on Android 9 another app with broad storage permission may be able to read it. Android’s Download Manager receives the access token as a request header and handles transfer/retry. ShelfDrive rejects endpoints that redirect during its preflight, and your reverse proxy should serve audio directly because a later redirect may receive replayed request headers.

JediBkApps does not operate your Audiobookshelf server, receive this data, sell it, or use it for advertising. Disconnecting cancels that account’s pending downloads and removes its server linkage, but completed offline books remain until you delete them in Offline Audiobooks settings or clear app storage. Use your server to delete server-side records. Contact christianbrooker@gmail.com with privacy questions. The complete policy is also available using “View online.”
